💥 **IRDAI vs Star Health Insurance: What You Need to Know Before You Buy!** 💥

If you've ever watched the movie *Tagore*, you’ll remember how the hero targets corrupt officials. In real life, **IRDAI** – the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India** – is now taking a similar stand in the **insurance sector**.  

This video dives deep into the **recent investigation by IRDAI on health insurance companies**, especially **Star Health Insurance**, which has been flagged for:

✅ Delaying and rejecting large numbers of claims  
✅ Extremely low claim settlement ratio  
✅ Thousands of customer complaints  
✅ Poor service for non-network hospitals  
✅ Incorrect medical history tagging  
✅ Data breach affecting 3 crore customers  

📉 According to IRDAI 2023–24 data:  
🔹 Star Health’s claim payout ratio is only **66.47%**, way below the industry average  
🔹 **2.96 lakh claims rejected** in just one year  
🔹 Over **16,800 customer complaints** – the highest among private insurers  

😱 Shocking real-life stories included – from maternity claims to COVID-19 treatment cases – exposing how policyholders, including myself since 2007, received as little as 25% of their actual bill amounts.

🎯 **What You’ll Learn in This Video:**  
🔹 What is IRDAI doing about these issues?  
🔹 Can you port your health insurance to another company?  
🔹 How to file a complaint directly with IRDAI?  
🔹 Why financial advisors don’t recommend Star Health anymore  

📌 **Important Links Mentioned in Video:**  
▶ File a Complaint: https://bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in  
▶ IRDAI Email: complaints@irdai.gov.in  
▶ Toll-Free Numbers: 155255 or 1800 4254 732
